accepted.reason: CVE-2026-133622 (CVSS 3.1 3.7, availability only): certmonger sets no size limit or transfer timeout on SCEP replies, so a malicious CA or an attacker on an unencrypted path can exhaust memory or hang a request. No distribution has a fixed version. Haprion takes only https endpoints (check_endpoint in src/haprion/ndes_profiles.py) on servers confirmed in the runtime policy, so the path is encrypted to a CA the operator chose. Each enrollment starts its own certmonger, which is killed when the enrollment returns, at the latest after its 90-second deadline (ENROLL_TIMEOUT in src/haprion/ndes.py). The helper runs under sudo from the worker without pam_systemd, so it stays in the worker's cgroup and its MemoryMax=768M. The worst case is one failed enrollment and a restarted worker.
